skills.name: agnix

Run the agnix CLI, explain its diagnostics, and apply explicitly requested safe fixes across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Kiro, OpenCode, and related tools.

skills.name: github-project-delegation
skills.description: Plan and coordinate software projects in GitHub Projects v2 using the mcp-github-project-manager MCP server. Use for backlog triage, PRD-to-issue breakdown, sprint planning, human or AI-agent delegation, cross-agent handoffs, progress/risk reporting, review gates, and blocked or stale task recovery.

skills.name: gum-cli
skills.description: Use Charmbracelet Gum to build polished interactive shell scripts with prompts, selectors, filters, spinners, formatting, tables, pagers, logging, and styled terminal output. Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging shell workflows that invoke the `gum` CLI.

skills.name: ink
skills.description: Use when building, debugging, testing, or reviewing an Ink (React terminal CLI) application. Covers Ink 8 APIs, Node and React compatibility, components, input/paste, focus, terminal dimensions, scrolling, lifecycle, accessibility, and testing.

skills.name: ink-testing-library
skills.description: Write, improve, and debug automated tests for React-based Ink terminal/CLI components using the ink-testing-library package. Use when testing rendered terminal output, interactive keyboard input, rerenders, asynchronous UI changes, stdout/stderr frames, or teardown in Ink apps. Do not use for browser React DOM tests or when only a one-shot renderToString assertion is needed.

skills.name: justfile-expert
skills.description: Just command runner expertise — Justfile syntax, recipes, parameters, modules, shebang recipes. Use when authoring justfiles, project commands, or task automation.

skills.name: knap-skill
skills.description: Write, explain, validate, and render Knap templates for Markdown or text output. Use for Knap variables, filters, conditions, loops, local assignments, CLI rendering, or batch generation; do not apply to unrelated Jinja, Liquid, or Mustache templates.

skills.name: readme-crafter-skill
skills.description: Creates repository-specific README.md files that act as landing pages, onboarding guides, and trust signals. Use when the user asks to write, rewrite, improve, audit, localize, or restructure a README, or when a codebase needs a GitHub-facing project overview. Common triggers include "write a README", "improve my README", "generate README.md", "rewrite this project overview", and "make this repo easier to understand". Adapts to libraries, CLI tools, apps, research repos, browser extensions, internal tools, monorepos, and bilingual README workflows.

skills.name: serena-usage
skills.description: Serena MCP for project memory and code navigation. Use when managing Serena memories, navigating symbols, performing intelligent refactoring, or maintaining context/continuity across AI agent sessions.

skills.name: ue4ss-bridge
skills.description: Inspect and manipulate a live, running Unreal Engine game through the ue4ss-bridge MCP server (UE4SS plus the UEBridge Lua mod). Use this whenever the user wants to examine UObjects, properties, UFunctions or class hierarchies in a running game; read or change a value live; run Lua inside the game; snapshot/diff or watch/hook values while they play; find out what the camera is aimed at; trigger UE4SS dumps (usmap, jmap, uht, cxx); or whenever ue4ss-bridge tools (bridge_status, inspect_object, eval_lua, snapshot_object, watch_property, hook_function, poll_events, etc.) are available. Also trigger on mentions of UE4SS, UEBridge, Unreal game modding or reverse engineering, "the player pawn/controller", or finding offsets and property names in a live game, even if the user never names the tool.

skills.name: vhs-cli
skills.description: Create and verify reproducible terminal recordings using Charmbracelet VHS. Use for .tape authoring, CLI/TUI demos, GIF/MP4/WebM recording, terminal screenshots, and ASCII golden fixtures. Offers simple (lint without rendering) and expanded (render, inspect, review) workflows.

skills.name: vitest-testing
